label_semantics.definition: For task T = (map_seed, seat, opponent) and arm X (one of the 13 D169a options), if X's own D169a-frozen arming precondition is satisfied at some turn under the exact resident's play (budget-1: X is the only option ever engaged in that simulation, from t=0, though it does nothing until its own natural activation point), label(T,X) = (own_score(T,X) - opponent_score(T,X)) - (own_score(T,control) - opponent_score(T,control)) using the exact same full-game simulation D169a itself runs per (task,arm). This is byte-identical to D169a's own per-(task,arm) paired margin. No regression target is ever fitted from another policy's trajectories.
label_semantics.decision_state: A decision state is (map_seed, seat, opponent, turn) where 1 or more of the 13 arms' arming preconditions hold simultaneously, discovered by walking the exact-resident (all-KEEP-equivalent) trajectory once per task and reproducing D170's own refresh_candidates gating exactly (workers==2 gate for fixed marks 72/104/136; sticky trig_pending flag latched post-step and consumed next call, per the D170b Delta-1 repair; sticky return_pending flag latched post-step at entry_turn when bank_fruit_total>0 and consumed next call). State features (the 64-field state family) are read at the START of that turn, before any option ever engages - identical to control up to that point, so there is no train/deploy covariate shift at budget-1 (the policy's pre-intervention distribution IS the labeling distribution).
label_semantics.cross_validation: Every task's candidate-offer list (from the scanning pass) is asserted 1:1 against d169a_play's own `activated` boolean for all 13 arms during corpus generation (panic on any mismatch) - a continuous, whole-corpus consistency check, not just a 32-sample spot check.

phase2_signal_floor.unit_of_analysis: decision state (map_seed,seat,opponent,turn) grouped from the corpus; max-option label = max(label) over the candidates offered at that state
phase2_signal_floor.frozen_floor: coverage_rate = (#states with max-option label >= +2.0) / (#states) >= 0.08, AND at least one such state in both seat=0 and seat=1, AND at least 6 of the 8 opponent families represented among such states
phase2_signal_floor.kill_verdict: CLOSED-AT-SIGNAL if below floor - not softened.

linear.form: per-option linear scorer: score(x)[k] = W[k,:] . x + b[k] for k in 0..12 (13 arms), x = the full 81-field per-(state,option) input vector

mlp.form: shared trunk Linear(81->16) + ReLU, then 13 linear per-option heads Linear(16->1) each (equivalently one Linear(16->13))

phase3_function_classes.loss: Huber loss (delta=1.0, PyTorch nn.HuberLoss default), supervised regression of the selected option-head's prediction against the row's exact label; only the head matching the row's own one-hot arm receives gradient from that row
phase3_function_classes.training: one deterministic thread per fit (torch.set_num_threads(1)); fixed seed controls init + minibatch shuffling; 4 fits total (2 function classes x 2 seeds)
phase3_function_classes.runtime_rule: tau = +1.0 (frozen). At each decision turn, gather the FULL set of simultaneously-armable candidates before deciding (true argmax over that turn's offered group, not greedy-first-that-clears); score each via the fitted model reading off its own arm's head; invoke the argmax candidate iff its predicted value > tau; else KEEP all and continue. Budget: at most one INVOKE per game.

phase3_admission_gates.selection_among_admitted: max worst_block -> tie: max pooled_mean -> tie: lowest seed (fit-side statistics forbidden as selectors, D131/D134)
